public_open_space.name: 49 Stevenson St
public_open_space.location: In front of building on Stevenson Street and through a pedestrianized alley to Jessie Street
public_open_space.description: This pedestrian walkway has small fountains and an art sculpture are featured in this space. Plaza seating is available for patrons of Yank Sing restaurant only.
public_open_space.seating: 20 chairs, taken inside before 5pm at time of last site visit.

public_art.title: Escalieta I
public_art.access: open space and artwork is always accessible
public_art.detail: Escalieta I is a marble sculpture by Manuel Neri (1930-2021), an American sculptor and a leading member of the Bay Area Figurative Movement's "second generation," installed at 49 Stevenson Street through San Francisco's 1% Public Art Program.
